verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. W2 and W4 now return Outcome::Failed whenever any non-empty compiled ODRL policy is unparseable, so a dropped prohibition cannot silently widen access; the added regression constructs a parseable allow plus an unparseable prohibition and verifies both lanes fail. The non-canonical numeric work-box timing claim has also been removed and replaced with qualitative, explicitly non-canonical wording. The fail-closed checks precede materialization in both lanes, and the regression includes a non-vacuous allow-only control, so it is not vacuous. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the supplied diff.
